mapper.sql: select g.group_id, g.class_id, c.class_name, g.task_id, g.group_name, g.leader_id, u.nick_name as leader_name, g.member_min, g.member_max, g.group_type, g.status, g.create_by, g.create_time, g.update_time from edu_group g left join edu_class c on c.class_id = g.class_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = g.leader_id
mapper.insert: insert into edu_group (class_id, task_id, group_name, leader_id, member_min, member_max, group_type, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{classId}, #{taskId}, #{groupName}, #{leaderId}, #{memberMin}, #{memberMax}, #{groupType}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate())

mapper.select: select m.id, m.group_id, m.user_id, u.nick_name as student_name, p.student_no, m.confirm_status, m.contribution, m.join_time from edu_group_member m left join sys_user u on u.user_id = m.user_id left join edu_user_profile p on p.user_id = m.user_id where m.group_id = #{groupId} order by m.id
